basis: Publisher ingredient lists and preparation methods. Counted bunches/leaves/sprigs are not converted to assumed gram weights.

replace: small bunch parsley chopped, plus a little to serve
corrections.note: One small bunch of parsley is included for the garlic butter; garnish is extra. Bunches remain separate from weighed herb stock; no gram conversion is assumed.

replace: bundle of woody herbs (bouquet garni) – we used 2 bay leaves, 3 sage leaves and 4 thyme sprigs, plus a few thyme leaves to serve
corrections.note: Includes the publisher's herb bundle: two bay leaves, three sage leaves and four thyme sprigs for four servings. Bunches remain separate from weighed herb stock; no gram conversion is assumed.

replace: small bunch of basil roughly chopped, plus a few extra leaves to serve
corrections.note: Includes one small bunch of basil for the cooked sauce; garnish is extra. Bunches remain separate from weighed herb stock; no gram conversion is assumed.

replace: small bunch coriander roughly chopped, plus a few leaves to serve
corrections.note: Includes one small bunch of coriander stirred through the rice; garnish is extra. Bunches remain separate from weighed herb stock; no gram conversion is assumed.

replace: bunch spring onion sliced - save 1 for serving, if eating straight away; good grating fresh nutmeg plus extra to serve
corrections.note: Includes one bunch of spring onions; reserve one onion from that bunch for serving if desired. Freshly grated nutmeg is also required in the soup, but the publisher gives no measured amount: check it before shopping; it is not quantified in automatic shopping or stock deductions. Bunches remain separate from weighed herb stock; no gram conversion is assumed.

replace: small bunch coriander chopped, plus extra, shredded, to serve
corrections.note: Includes one small bunch of coriander split between the filling and avocado; garnish is extra. Bunches remain separate from weighed herb stock; no gram conversion is assumed.
